skills.name: Convert Mixed Numbers
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number into an improper fraction.

skills.name: Common Denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for fractions with unlike denominators.

skills.name: Subtract Fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators.

skills.name: Simplify Fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms or convert an improper fraction to a mixed number.
